pages.text: The $(item)Binding Circle$() writes a spell into a ring.

pages.name: Binding Circle
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, the core in its middle, candles on the sides.

pages.title: Imbuing
pages.text: I lay a spell ring in the circle, choose a spell and pay its price. I chant while the ring rises and takes it. Each ring holds one spell, of its own tier or lower.$(br2)Unbinding costs Sorrow and a little blood.
